text:
maria_csm: Hey team — kicking off Sundial Health onboarding. Quick context: they're planning to run Redwood Private in their AWS VPC for PHI workloads. Target go‑live = 8 weeks from today. Wanted to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and immediate blockers. External contacts: Priya (Sundial PM), Dan (Sundial Security). Internal owners I propose: Maria = CSM, Alex = Solutions Eng, Joanne = Platform Eng, Ken = Ops, Sam = Enablement, Ruth = Program/rollout. Please confirm and call out any missing pieces.

maria_csm: Success criteria (suggested):
- Secure VPC peering and private endpoints validated
- SSO (SAML) configured end-to-end with user provisioning
- Data ingestion validated for PHI schema with signed POE
- End‑to‑end latency within 250ms p50 for 95% of demo flows
- Training + runbook delivered to Sundial eng + ops teams

maria_csm: Proposed high‑level timeline:
1) Week 0 (this week): stakeholder kickoff, gather SAML metadata and sample payloads
2) Week 1–2: infra prep (VPC, firewall, certs, KMS) + network tests
3) Week 3–4: integration (API keys, model mapping, sample data tests)
4) Week 5: pilot with limited traffic (canary)
5) Week 6–7: iterate on fixes and runbook updates
6) Week 8: go‑live + 30d health check

maria_csm: Major risks I see up front: SSO metadata delay, missing PHI field mapping, cert/KMS provisioning time, and any SOC2/contract docs the customer needs signed.

alex_se: I can own the SE side — model mapping, API contract, test payload harness. I need sample payloads and SAML metadata from Priya. I’ll produce an integration checklist by EOW. :+1:

sam_cs: I’ll take enablement & training. Plan to run two 90min sessions (devs + ops) and produce a quickstart doc + recording. Will also own success metric dashboard (uptime, p50/p95 latency, error rate).

joanne_eng: I’ll validate VPC connectivity and run the network checklist. Quick Q: what peak RPS should we plan for during pilot and go‑live? that affects pooling and batch config.

ken_ops: I’ll handle cert provisioning and KMS access. I’ll need the customer’s KMS ARN or we can provide our KMS path if they prefer. Also need a copy of any compliance asks (SOC2/BAA).

ruth_pm: I’ll drive the rollout timeline and can own the canary plan. Suggestion: start with 10% traffic for 72h, automated fallback to hosted model if errors > 2% or latency > 1s.

maria_csm: @joanne_eng they expect modest load initially — estimate 50 RPS peak during pilot, 200 RPS at steady state. I’ll confirm numbers with Priya.

alex_se: Noted. That RPS is fine but we should plan autoscaling buffer and KV cache warmup strategy.

joanne_eng: perfect — I’ll add autoscale policy draft to the checklist.

ken_ops: Flags: certs usually take 3–5 business days if customer owns keys. If we need HSM/KMS integration for encryption at rest, add extra week.

maria_csm: Action items after this thread:
- Maria: confirm RPS + request SAML metadata and sample payloads (by Tue)
- Alex: integration checklist draft (EOW)
- Joanne: network checklist + autoscale draft (mid next week)
- Ken: cert/KMS runbook + list of required docs (by Wed)
- Sam: enablement plan + training dates (next Thurs/Fri)
- Ruth: canary config and rollback playbook (next Wed)

maria_csm: @onboardbot please schedule a 60min kickoff with Sundial and internal owners next Tuesday 11am PT and include calendar link in thread.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 11:00 AM PT — 60m — "Sundial Health: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Join: https://meet.example.com/abcd1234 (invites sent).

alex_se: :thumbsup: I’ll block time.

sam_cs: +1 — will prepare agenda and initial training slides.

ruth_pm: I’ll create a shared project board and add tasks from action items.

maria_csm: Great — thanks all. I’ll post updates here as we get artifacts from Sundial. If anyone sees a blocker that changes the timeline, flag it here or ping me directly. :rocket:
